environment.description: Deployed on ECS Fargate with a custom-built distroless container image (gcr.io/distroless/python3-debian12). Task definition specifies linuxParameters with a seccomp profile loaded from S3 that restricts syscalls to: read, write, open, close, stat, fstat, mmap, mprotect, munmap, brk, rt_sigaction, rt_sigprocmask, ioctl, access, pipe, select, sched_yield, clone, execve, exit_group, fcntl, getdents, lseek, poll, recvfrom, sendto, socket, connect, bind, listen, accept, getsockname, getpeername, setsockopt, futex, epoll_create, epoll_ctl, epoll_wait, clock_gettime, nanosleep, arch_prctl, set_tid_address, set_robust_list, prlimit64, getrandom. Additionally, the task runs with readonlyRootFilesystem: true, and the ECS task role has zero attached policies (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/ecs-diag-task-role with empty permission set). Network configuration uses awsvpc mode in a private subnet with a security group that only allows egress to the VPC CIDR range (10.0.0.0/16) on ports 80 and 443, with no internet gateway or NAT gateway route in the subnet's route table.

config.seccomp_profile: custom allowlist including execve but target binaries absent
config.subnet_type: private, no NAT, no IGW route
